title: NeuronEye: Query-Guided Visual Concept Activation for Vision-Language Reasoning

body: Current vision-language models (VLMs) encode visual information in dense hidden states where object identity, spatial layout, and local attributes are implicitly entangled rather than explicitly disentangled, limiting their ability to isolate and modulate the specific visual evidence required by a given language query. Inspired by sparse population coding and top-down modulation in biological vision, we introduce NeuronEye, a plug-in framework that constructs a sparse, concept-level neuron vocabulary from intermediate VLM representations and selectively activates query-relevant visual concepts during inference. NeuronEye decomposes vision-token states into an overcomplete sparse basis organized by concept-level clusters, uses the language query to activate relevant clusters and localize the patches where selected concepts are expressed, and injects the focused evidence back into vision tokens. A complementary suppression mechanism attenuates dominant perceptual directions to preserve weaker but relevant cues. All operations run in a single forward pass over a frozen VLM backbone. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, NeuronEye raises CV-Bench overall accuracy by +3.1 with gains of +9.5 on Distance, and improves BLINK Multi-view by +8.3, with similar trends on LLaVA-1.6-7B. These results suggest that sparse neuron vocabularies can serve not only as post-hoc interpretability tools but also as active interfaces for concept-level visual reasoning.
summaryZh: 本文提出了NeuronEye框架，旨在解决视觉语言模型（VLM）中视觉信息与语言查询难以解耦的问题。该框架通过构建稀疏的概念级神经元词汇表，在推理过程中根据查询动态激活相关视觉概念，并抑制无关信息。实验显示，该方法在Qwen2.5-VL等模型上显著提升了视觉推理准确率，证明了稀疏神经元词汇表不仅可用于模型解释，还能作为主动的视觉推理接口。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该研究提出的NeuronEye框架通过稀疏概念激活提升了视觉语言模型的推理能力，并提供了良好的可解释性。

glossary.explanationZh: 概念激活，指在模型内部定位并增强与特定语义概念相关的神经元响应。
稀疏基，用于将复杂的隐藏状态分解为可解释的、稀疏的概念表示。
自上而下的调节，指利用高层语义查询来引导底层视觉特征的处理。
视觉语言模型，能够同时处理图像和文本输入的多模态模型。
